exclusion_detail: Lead 52a1 is made in 5 reactions from commercial ethyl 1-benzyl-4-oxopiperidine-3-carboxylate HCl (5a): guanidine carbonate cyclisation (6a), hydrogenolytic debenzylation (50), N-acylation with 2-methylthiazole-4-carbonyl chloride, POCl3 chlorination (51a), SNAr with (S)-3-aminohexan-1-ol (52a1). SI gives each as a separate 'Step' with isolation.

lead.label: 52a1
lead.why: Abstract: 'Optimization of this series ... resulted in the identification of compound 52a1' (also the compound taken into mouse PK/PD).

notes: Target SMILES given only for reference (ring-fusion atom order of the SMILES was not independently checked). Qualifying others are intermediates that are also tested compounds: 8a is 3 steps (guanidine, POCl3, n-butylamine), 9a is 4 (plus hydrogenolysis); 8b/9b are 'similar method' from the regioisomeric ketoester, not separately detailed. Counting the SI's two 'Step' pairs for 50 and 51a as separate reactions; if the paper's 'in two steps' were read as two one-pot operations the count would still be 5 distinct operations.
